profile.name: Faraz Khan
profile.title: Software Engineer
profile.tagline: I build clean, fast and reliable software — and occasionally score goals.
about: Hi! I'm a software engineer who enjoys turning ideas into products people actually use. I like working across the stack — from designing APIs and data pipelines to crafting responsive user interfaces.
Outside of work you'll find me on the football pitch, exploring new tech, or building small side projects (like the games further down this page).

highlights: Member of the college football team
Core courses: Data Structures, Algorithms, DBMS, Operating Systems, Computer Networks

experience.description: Working on backend services and web applications used by thousands of customers.
highlights: Designed and shipped REST APIs in Python, reducing response times by 40%
Built reusable React components adopted across 3 internal products
Set up CI/CD pipelines and automated testing

experience.description: Contributed to the internal analytics dashboard.
highlights: Automated weekly reports, saving the team ~6 hours a week

projects.title: This Portfolio
projects.description: A JSON-driven React portfolio with a built-in arcade of mini games. Every section on the page is generated from a single data file.

projects.title: Task Manager API
projects.description: A RESTful task management backend with authentication, role-based access and full test coverage.

projects.title: Weather Dashboard
projects.description: A responsive dashboard that shows live weather and 7-day forecasts for any city, with charts and saved locations.

extras.description: Football has been a huge part of my life. I played for my college team, representing the college in inter-college tournaments. It taught me teamwork, discipline and how to stay calm under pressure — lessons I carry into every project.
highlights: Played for the college team throughout my degree
Competed in inter-college and university tournaments
